findings.claim: The developer, GuocoLand Limited, carries Singapore registration number 197600660W, stated in its own SGX-filed annual reports.
GuocoLand has been listed on the Singapore Exchange since 1978, incorporated 31 March 1976.
GuocoLand states on its own website that it has developed over 11,000 homes across more than 40 residential projects in Singapore.
findings.note: This site is named after the project. Sites like this are usually run by estate agents, not the developer.

findings.claim: River Modern is a 455-unit, 99-year leasehold development across two 36-storey towers, launched for public viewing 20 February 2026.
GuocoLand secured the site through a Government Land Sales tender with a top bid of S$627.84 million, approximately S$1,420 per square foot per plot ratio.
About 70% of units are described as having unblocked river views.
Units start from approximately S$1.548 million.
GuocoLand's own exchange filings report Midtown Bay completed in the second quarter of 2024 and Lentor Modern, 605 units, in the third quarter of 2025.
GuocoLand's FY2022 results say Martin Modern sold all 450 units, which have since been handed over to their owners.
A December 2021 filing said GuocoLand's Singapore projects were expected to meet revised completion targets despite construction labour shortages.
GuocoLand's January 2026 results confirm River Modern: 455 units in two towers, wholly developed by GuocoLand, launching in early 2026.
River Modern's estimated Temporary Occupation Permit (TOP) date is the second half of 2030.
The developer's statutory disclosure gives expected vacant possession by 31 December 2032 and legal completion by 31 December 2035 — the contractual deadlines, later than the estimated TOP.
The developer is River Modern Pte. Ltd., housing developer licence C1539; the land is mortgaged to OCBC, as is normal for project financing.
Reporting GuocoLand's August 2026 exchange filing, EdgeProp says River Modern was 93% sold by 30 June, at an average of S$3,266 per sq ft.

conflicts.topic: Direct connection to Great World MRT station

versions.value: Directly connected to Great World MRT via a sheltered/underground walkway
Not mentioned as directly connected — nearest station described only generally

reading.observation: The 'direct MRT connection' claim appears consistently on agent and marketing microsites but not in the one genuinely independent property-portal source checked (99.co). This is the same agent-microsite pattern this product watches for in every market.
reading.question: Can the sales team point to the specific underground link on Great World MRT's own station map?

reading.observation: Singapore projects carry two kinds of date. The estimated TOP (2H 2030 here) is a forecast; the statutory dates in the sale documents (vacant possession by 31 December 2032) are the contractual deadlines. Listings quoting July 2029 are wrong on both counts.
reading.question: What vacant-possession date is in my Option to Purchase and Sale and Purchase Agreement, and what is the current estimated TOP?

questions.question: Is River Modern's seller GuocoLand Limited (UEN 197600660W) directly, or a separate project subsidiary?
questions.good: A specific project-company name and UEN, distinct from or matching the parent.

questions.question: What is the Option to Purchase's expiry date, and is my booking fee refundable if I do not exercise it?
questions.good: A specific date and a written refund policy for the booking fee itself.

questions.question: Under the Housing Developers Rules, which construction milestone does each payment instalment correspond to?
questions.good: A written progressive-payment schedule tied to specific milestones.
questions.red_flag: A payment request with no milestone stated.
